pli-tv-bu-vb-pd1:0.5: Ime kho panāyasmanto cattāro pāṭidesaniyā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd1:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd1:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā bhikkhunī Sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā paṭikkamanakāle aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ passitvā etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd1:1.5: sā upakaṭṭhe kāle nāsakkhi piṇḍāya carituṃ, chinnabhattā ahosi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd1:1.6: atha kho sā bhikkhunī dutiyam pi divasaṃ --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd1:1.7: tatiyam pi divasaṃ Sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā paṭikkamanakāle taṃ bhikkhuṃ passitvā etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd1:1.11: atha kho sā bhikkhunī catutthe divase rathiyāya pavedhantī gacchati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd1:1.12: seṭṭhi gahapati rathena paṭipathaṃ āgacchanto taṃ bhikkhuniṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd1:1.20: atha kho sā bhikkhunī seṭṭhissa gahapatissa etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd1:1.21: seṭṭhi gahapati taṃ bhikkhuniṃ gharaṃ netvā bhojetvā ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd1:1.22: kathañ hi nāma bhaddantā bhikkhuniyā hatthato āmisaṃ paṭiggahessanti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd1:1.24: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tassa seṭṭhissa gahapatissa . . . vipācentassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd1:1.26: kathañ hi nāma bhikkhu bhikkhuniyā hatthato āmisaṃ paṭiggahessatīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd1:1.27: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ bhikkhu bhikkhuniyā hatthato āmisaṃ paṭiggahesīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd1:1.31: aññātako moghapurisa aññātikāya na jānāti patirūpaṃ vā appatirūpaṃ vā santaṃ vā asantaṃ vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd1:1.32: kathañ hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā hatthato āmisaṃ paṭiggahessasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd1:1.33: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd1:1.34: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd1:1.35.1: yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā antaragharaṃ paviṭṭhāya hatthato khādaniyaṃ vā bhojaniyaṃ vā sahatthā paṭiggahetvā khādeyya vā bhuñjeyya vā, paṭidesetabbaṃ tena bhikkhunā
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd1:1.36: gārayhaṃ āvuso dhammaṃ āpajjiṃ asappāyaṃ pāṭidesaniyaṃ taṃ paṭidesemīti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd1:2.1.6: mātito vā pitito vā yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā asambaddhā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd1:2.1.12: pañca bhojanāni yāmakālikaṃ sattāhakālikaṃ yāvajīvikaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ khādaniyaṃ nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd1:2.1.14: pañca bhojanāni odano kummāso sattu maccho maṃsaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd1:2.2.1: aññātikāya aññātikasaññī antaragharaṃ paviṭṭhāya hatthato khādaniyaṃ vā bhojaniyaṃ vā sahatthā paṭiggahetvā khādati vā bhuñjati vā, āpatti pāṭidesaniyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd1:2.2.4: yāmakālikaṃ sattāhakālikaṃ yāvajīvikaṃ āhāratthāya paṭigaṇhāti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
